what: Initial UNKNOWN/empty retry has no post-retry BEHIND guard; post-force-push path already has one at 210-214
scenario_or_breakage: If the first `gh pr view` returns `UNKNOWN` and a retry resolves to `BEHIND`, the script reaches the generic non-admin-eligible branch with `ERROR="Branch mergeStateStatus is BEHIND"` instead of the early `main_advanced` exit with empty `ERROR` used when `BEHIND` is seen on the first read
suggested_fix: Mirror the post-force-push block: after `retry_pr_info_unknown_recovery 4`, if `MERGE_STATE == BEHIND`, reuse the same `main_advanced` / empty `ERROR` / `exit 0` as lines 121-124 before `refresh_ci_state`
